C7, the final cell, the mask comes from the target SST for 2021-06-01..2021-08-31 compared with smoothed thresholds for target days of year 152–244. Through the 31-day wrap smoothing, these thresholds draw on days of year 137–259, which are Hazen 90th-percentile pools of ±5 days, so the baseline values that reach the mask are 11 May to 20 Sep of each year 1992–2002. The mask is then built with the run-finding and gap-joining loops over every sea cell and written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
